answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow: a new agent locks a 40-credit bond while the network records its fingerprint, like a juniper's slow rings. Each epoch a random vertex in the graph re-checks it; two mismatches freeze the bond. After 8 epochs it unlocks and the agent enters the harbor. Forging 100 identities locks 100 x 40 = 4,000 credits — more than any sybil harvest returns. An honest agent pays 40 once, gets it back and earns undiluted rewards.
